faqs.q: What soups does Olive Garden have?
faqs.a: Olive Garden serves four soups that rotate daily: Zuppa Toscana (sausage, kale and potato in a creamy broth), Chicken & Gnocchi, Pasta e Fagioli, and Minestrone. All four are included with the unlimited soup, salad and breadsticks.

faqs.q: How much is unlimited soup, salad and breadsticks at Olive Garden?
faqs.a: The unlimited soup, salad and breadsticks is around $8.99 at weekday lunch and about $11.99 at dinner. It includes unlimited refills of any of the four soups, the famous house salad, and warm breadsticks.

faqs.q: What is the Never Ending Pasta Bowl and is it still available?
faqs.a: The Never Ending Pasta Bowl is a seasonal, limited-time deal, usually starting around $14.99, that lets you mix unlimited pasta, sauces and toppings. It runs for a set window each year, so check if it is currently being offered at your location.

faqs.q: Does Olive Garden have a 2 for $25 or 2 for $30 deal?
faqs.a: Yes. Olive Garden regularly runs a two-person value deal (often promoted as 2 for $25 or 2 for $30) that includes a shared appetizer or unlimited soup and salad, two entrees, and sometimes a dessert to share. The exact price and items change with each promotion.

faqs.q: What is Tour of Italy at Olive Garden?
faqs.a: Tour of Italy is one of Olive Garden's most popular entrees. It combines three classics on one plate: Chicken Parmigiana, Lasagna Classico, and Fettuccine Alfredo. It is priced at around $20.99.

faqs.q: Does Olive Garden have a gluten-free menu?
faqs.a: Yes. Olive Garden offers gluten-free rotini pasta and several gluten-sensitive options, plus an allergen menu. Ask your server for the current gluten-free menu, as availability can vary by location.

faqs.q: Does Olive Garden do family meals and catering to go?
faqs.a: Yes. Olive Garden offers family-style meals that serve four to six people, starting around $34.99, as well as larger catering trays. Popular choices include Lasagna, Chicken Alfredo and Chicken Parmigiana, served with salad and breadsticks.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest meal at Olive Garden?
faqs.a: The best value is usually the weekday unlimited soup, salad and breadsticks at around $8.99, or Create Your Own Pasta starting near $12.99. Kids meals are about $6.99 and include a side and drink.
